question: Who cared for King David in his old age by lying in his bosom to keep him warm?
explanation: Abishag the Shunammite ministered to David in his old age.

question: Which son of David exalted himself saying, 'I will be king'?
explanation: Adonijah attempted to seize the throne.

question: Who reminded David of his promise that Solomon would reign after him?
explanation: Nathan and Bathsheba acted together to secure Solomon's succession.

question: At what location was Solomon anointed king by Zadok the priest?
explanation: Solomon was anointed at Gihon.

question: How did Adonijah respond when he learned Solomon had been made king?
choices: He feared and caught hold on the horns of the altar
explanation: Adonijah fled to the altar in fear.

question: What did David charge Solomon to do as his death drew near?
choices: Be strong and show himself a man
explanation: David urged Solomon to be strong and faithful.

question: What did David say Solomon must keep to prosper?
choices: The charge of the Lord and His commandments
explanation: David stressed covenant obedience.

question: Why was Adonijah executed?
choices: He asked for Abishag as wife
explanation: Asking for Abishag was treated as a renewed grasp at the throne.

question: Whom did Solomon remove from the priesthood, fulfilling the word against Eli's house?
explanation: Abiathar was thrust out from being priest.

question: What happened to Shimei after he violated Solomon's command about leaving Jerusalem?
explanation: Shimei's disobedience brought his execution.

question: With which foreign king did Solomon make a marriage alliance early in his reign?
explanation: Solomon made affinity with Pharaoh king of Egypt and married Pharaoh's daughter.

question: At what place did Solomon offer a great sacrifice of a thousand burnt offerings?
explanation: Solomon worshiped at the great high place at Gibeon.

question: What did Solomon ask God for in his dream?
choices: An understanding heart to judge the people
explanation: Solomon requested wisdom to discern judgment.

question: What famous case showed Solomon's wisdom soon after?
choices: Two women claiming one living child
explanation: Solomon's ruling between the two mothers revealed his God-given wisdom.

question: What did God give Solomon in addition to wisdom because he had not asked selfishly?
explanation: God added riches and honor to the wisdom Solomon requested.

question: Who served as priest alongside Zadok in Solomon's administration?
explanation: Zadok and Abiathar are listed among Solomon's officials.

question: How many officers provided victuals for Solomon's household, each serving one month?
explanation: Twelve officers each provided provisions one month per year.

question: How are Judah and Israel described under Solomon's reign?
choices: As many as the sand which is by the sea in multitude
explanation: The kingdom is described as flourishing and numerous.

question: What natural-world subjects is Solomon said to have spoken about?
choices: Trees, beasts, fowl, creeping things, and fishes
explanation: The text highlights Solomon's broad wisdom about creation.

question: From where did people come to hear Solomon's wisdom?
choices: Out of all people and kings of the earth
explanation: His reputation drew people from many nations.

question: Which king sent servants to Solomon because he had heard he was anointed king?
explanation: Hiram of Tyre initiated contact with Solomon.

question: Why had David not built the house for the Lord according to Solomon?
explanation: David's wars prevented him from building the temple.

question: What material from Lebanon did Solomon request from Hiram?
explanation: Solomon requested cedar trees from Lebanon.

question: How many men did Solomon raise as a levy from Israel for the work?
explanation: Solomon raised a levy of thirty thousand men.

question: What did Solomon give Hiram year by year as food for his household?
explanation: Solomon gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat and twenty measures of pure oil year by year.

question: In what year of Solomon's reign did he begin to build the house of the Lord?
explanation: The temple began in Solomon's fourth year.

question: What material lined the inside of the temple walls?
explanation: Cedar lined the inner walls and ceiling.

question: With what did Solomon overlay the inside of the house?
explanation: The temple interior was richly overlaid with gold.

question: How many years did it take Solomon to build the temple?
explanation: The temple was finished in seven years.

question: What promise did the Lord give Solomon during the building if he walked in His statutes?
choices: I will dwell among the children of Israel and not forsake my people
explanation: God promised His dwelling presence conditioned on obedience.

question: How many years did Solomon spend building his own house?
explanation: Solomon spent thirteen years building his own house.

question: What were the names of the two bronze pillars at the temple entrance?
explanation: The pillars were named Jachin and Boaz.

question: Who was the skilled craftsman from Tyre who worked on the temple furnishings?
explanation: Hiram of Tyre was filled with wisdom to work in brass.

question: What large bronze object rested on twelve oxen?
explanation: The molten sea stood upon twelve oxen.

question: What did Solomon bring into the house of the Lord after the work was completed?
choices: The things which David his father had dedicated
explanation: Solomon brought in the dedicated silver, gold, and vessels of David.

question: What did the priests bring into the most holy place of the temple?
explanation: The ark was brought into the oracle under the wings of the cherubim.

question: What happened when the priests came out of the holy place?
choices: A cloud filled the house of the Lord
explanation: The glory-cloud filled the house so the priests could not stand to minister.

question: What did Solomon say heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot do?
explanation: Solomon marveled that even heaven could not contain God, much less the house he built.

question: What repeated phrase marks Solomon's prayer for various future situations?
explanation: Solomon repeatedly asks God to hear in heaven and act.

question: How many oxen did Solomon offer as peace offerings when the house of the Lord was dedicated?
explanation: Solomon offered 22,000 oxen and 120,000 sheep as peace offerings at the dedication.

question: How many times had the Lord appeared to Solomon by this point?
explanation: The Lord appeared to Solomon the second time.

question: What warning did God give if Solomon or his children turned from following Him?
choices: Israel would be cut off and the house become a proverb and byword
explanation: God warned of severe covenant judgment for apostasy.

question: What had Solomon given Hiram in return for cedar and gold, though Hiram was displeased?
explanation: Hiram called them the land of Cabul.

question: Who built the house that Pharaoh's daughter moved into when she left the city of David?
explanation: Pharaoh's daughter came up out of the city of David to her house, which Solomon had built for her.

question: What seafaring venture is described at the end of the chapter?
choices: A navy at Ezion-geber with Hiram's servants
Ships to Tarshish from Joppa only
explanation: Solomon built a navy at Ezion-geber in partnership with Hiram.

question: Why did the queen of Sheba come to Solomon?
choices: To prove him with hard questions
explanation: She came because of his fame and to test his wisdom.

question: What precious gift is highlighted among the queen's offerings?
explanation: The queen brought abundant spices, gold, and precious stones.

question: How did the queen react after seeing Solomon's wisdom and household order?
choices: There was no more spirit in her
explanation: She was overwhelmed by what she saw.

question: How many targets of beaten gold did Solomon make according to the chapter?
explanation: Solomon made two hundred targets of beaten gold. He also made three hundred shields.

question: From what country did Solomon have horses brought?
explanation: Solomon had horses brought out of Egypt.

question: What turned Solomon's heart away in his old age?
explanation: His foreign wives turned his heart after other gods.

question: Which two false gods does the chapter say Solomon went after?
explanation: Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Zidonians and Milcom the abomination of the Ammonites.

question: What judgment did God declare because of Solomon's unfaithfulness?
choices: The kingdom would be rent from him and given to his servant
explanation: God announced that the kingdom would be torn away.

question: Why would Solomon's son still retain part of the kingdom?
choices: For David's sake and for Jerusalem's sake
explanation: God delayed and limited judgment because of His promise to David and choice of Jerusalem.

question: What symbolic act did Ahijah perform when meeting Jeroboam?
choices: Rent a new garment into twelve pieces
explanation: Ahijah tore the garment into twelve pieces to symbolize the divided kingdom.

question: Where did all Israel come to make Rehoboam king?
explanation: The assembly to confirm Rehoboam was at Shechem.

question: What did the people ask Rehoboam to do regarding Solomon's rule?
explanation: They asked for relief from Solomon's heavy yoke.

question: Whose counsel did Rehoboam follow?
choices: The young men that grew up with him
explanation: He rejected the elders' counsel and followed the younger men.

question: What cry did the northern tribes raise after rejecting the house of David?
explanation: This cry marked the split of the kingdom.

question: Where did Jeroboam set up his two calves of gold?
explanation: Jeroboam set golden calves at Bethel and Dan.

question: From where did the man of God come to Bethel?
explanation: The prophet came out of Judah by the word of the Lord.

question: Which future king did the man of God name who would defile the altar at Bethel?
explanation: He specifically named Josiah long before his time.

question: What sign happened to Jeroboam's altar immediately?
choices: It was rent and the ashes poured out
explanation: The altar split apart as a confirming sign.

question: Why did the man of God die later on the road?
choices: He disobeyed God's command after listening to an old prophet
explanation: He died because he disobeyed the word of the Lord.

question: What strange detail marked the scene where the man of God died?
choices: The lion stood by the body and the ass
explanation: The lion did not devour the body but stood by it.

question: Which son of Jeroboam fell sick, prompting his wife to visit the prophet?
explanation: Jeroboam's son Abijah became sick.

question: To whom did Jeroboam's wife go in disguise?
explanation: She went to Ahijah in disguise to ask about the child.

question: What did Ahijah say would happen when Jeroboam's wife entered the city?
explanation: Ahijah foretold the boy's death upon her arrival.

question: What lasting judgment was pronounced on Jeroboam's house?
explanation: God pronounced destruction on Jeroboam's house.

question: Who came up against Jerusalem in Rehoboam's days and took treasures from the house of the Lord?
explanation: Shishak invaded and took away temple treasures.

question: How is Abijam's heart described compared to David's?
choices: Not perfect with the Lord his God
explanation: Abijam did not walk with a perfect heart like David.

question: What reforming king of Judah is commended for doing right in the eyes of the Lord?
explanation: Asa is praised for doing what was right like David.

question: What did Asa remove from the land as part of reform?
explanation: Asa removed idolatry and sodomites from the land.

question: Who smote Nadab and reigned in his stead over Israel?
explanation: Baasha killed Nadab and took the throne.

question: What sin of David is specifically excepted from his otherwise faithful life?
choices: The matter of Uriah the Hittite
explanation: The text singles out the matter of Uriah.

question: Which prophet brought the word of judgment against Baasha?
explanation: Jehu son of Hanani pronounced judgment on Baasha.

question: Who killed Elah while he was drinking himself drunk in Tirzah?
explanation: Zimri slew Elah and reigned in his stead.

question: How long did Zimri reign in Tirzah?
explanation: Zimri's reign lasted only seven days.

question: What did Zimri do when the city was taken and his position lost?
choices: Burned the king's house over himself and died
explanation: Zimri died by burning the palace over himself.

question: Which king bought the hill Samaria and built a city there?
explanation: Omri bought the hill and built Samaria.

question: What did Elijah declare before Ahab regarding dew and rain?
choices: Rain would fall in three days
There would be neither dew nor rain but according to his word
explanation: Elijah announced a drought at the word of the Lord.

question: How was Elijah fed by the brook Cherith?
explanation: Ravens brought him bread and flesh.

question: To what widow was Elijah sent during the famine?
explanation: Elijah was sent to the widow of Zarephath.

question: What miracle sustained the widow's household?
choices: The barrel of meal wasted not and the cruse of oil failed not
explanation: God provided a continuing supply of meal and oil.

question: What happened after Elijah stretched himself upon the widow's child three times?
choices: The child's soul came into him again
explanation: The child was restored to life.

question: Who feared the Lord greatly and hid a hundred prophets by fifties in caves?
explanation: Obadiah protected prophets during Jezebel's persecution.

question: What challenge did Elijah propose on Mount Carmel?
choices: The God who answers by fire, let him be God
explanation: Elijah's challenge centered on divine fire.

question: How many prophets of Baal were present at Carmel?
explanation: There were 450 prophets of Baal.

question: What did Elijah do to the altar before praying for fire?
choices: Poured water on the sacrifice and filled the trench
explanation: He soaked the offering to make the miracle unmistakable.

question: What small sign preceded the return of rain?
choices: A little cloud like a man's hand
explanation: A tiny cloud appeared before the heavens grew black with rain.

question: What threat from Jezebel caused Elijah to flee?
choices: That she would make his life as one of Baal's prophets by the next day
explanation: Jezebel threatened Elijah's life.

question: Under what tree did Elijah sit and ask that he might die?
explanation: Elijah sat under a juniper tree in despair.

question: How many days and nights did Elijah travel to Horeb in the strength of the angel's food?
explanation: He traveled forty days and forty nights to Horeb.

question: Which three things was the Lord not in, before the still small voice came?
explanation: The Lord was not in the wind, earthquake, or fire before the still small voice.

question: Whom was Elijah told to anoint as prophet in his room?
explanation: Elisha was called to succeed Elijah.

question: Which Syrian king came up against Samaria with a great host?
explanation: Ben-hadad besieged Samaria.

question: Who went out first from Samaria against the Syrians?
choices: The young men of the princes of the provinces
explanation: The young men of the princes of the provinces went out first, and the army followed them.

question: What mistaken theological assumption did the Syrians make about Israel's God?
choices: He was a god of the hills only
explanation: They wrongly assumed Israel's God was limited to the hills.

question: How did Ahab spare Ben-hadad after the second victory?
choices: He made a covenant with him and let him go
He set him free without condition
explanation: Ahab made a covenant with Ben-hadad and released him.

question: What message of judgment did the prophet give Ahab for sparing Ben-hadad?
choices: Thy life shall go for his life, and thy people for his people
explanation: Ahab was condemned for letting go the man God had devoted to destruction.

question: What did Ahab want from Naboth?
explanation: Ahab wanted Naboth's vineyard for a garden of herbs.

question: Why did Naboth refuse to sell the vineyard?
choices: It was the inheritance of his fathers
explanation: Naboth refused because it was ancestral inheritance.

question: What evil scheme did Jezebel use to take Naboth's vineyard?
choices: She arranged false witnesses so Naboth would be stoned
explanation: Jezebel orchestrated a false accusation of blasphemy.

question: What did Elijah say dogs would do in the place where Naboth was slain?
explanation: Elijah pronounced a judgment fitting the crime.

question: How did Ahab respond to Elijah's word of judgment?
choices: He humbled himself with sackcloth and fasting
explanation: Ahab humbled himself, and God delayed some judgment.

question: What city did Ahab and Jehoshaphat plan to recover from Syria?
explanation: They planned to go to battle for Ramoth-gilead.

question: How many prophets did Ahab gather who encouraged the campaign?
explanation: Ahab gathered about four hundred prophets.

question: Which prophet insisted that Ahab would fall if he went to battle?
explanation: Micaiah saw Israel scattered like sheep without a shepherd.

question: How did Ahab try to avoid Micaiah's prophecy in battle?
explanation: Ahab disguised himself while Jehoshaphat wore his robes.

question: What happened when a certain man drew a bow at a venture?
choices: He struck the king of Israel between the joints of the harness
explanation: The random shot mortally wounded Ahab.
